faqs.q: What is the 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 Inch (in) Pipe Thread Size Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot and what is it used for?
faqs.a: The 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 Inch Pipe Thread Size Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot is a sandblast coupling end: a female NPT pipe thread on one side and a crowfoot (claw) face on the other. It screws onto a 1-1/4" or 1-1/2" NPT male fitting and couples to a crowfoot half for blast hose.

faqs.q: How do the part numbers for the 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 Inch (in) Pipe Thread Size Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot read?
faqs.a: The maker's codes are SB 1AL for the 1-1/4" end and SB 2AL for the 1-1/2" end, where AL marks the aluminium body. Both sizes are listed with the female NPT pipe thread.

faqs.q: What sizes does the 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 Inch (in) Pipe Thread Size Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot come in?
faqs.a: The 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 Inch (in) Pipe Thread Size Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot is listed in 1-1/4" and 1-1/2", in 2 part numbers such as IH-SB-1-1-4-TO-1-1-2-INCH-IN-PIPE-THREAD-SIZE-125 and IH-SB-1-1-4-TO-1-1-2-INCH-IN-PIPE-THREAD-SIZE-150.

faqs.q: Which size do I need for a blast machine outlet or nozzle thread?
faqs.a: Match the NPT thread on the blast machine or fitting you are screwing onto: 1-1/4" or 1-1/2". This hose end has the female NPT thread, so it screws onto a male NPT fitting of the same size and then couples to a crowfoot half.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 Inch (in) Pipe Thread Size Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot?
faqs.a: The maker publishes 110 psi at 70°F for this aluminium female NPT crowfoot end, the only blast coupling on this shelf with a published rating. Derate for temperature and wear, and keep blast pressure at or below the hose and the lowest-rated part in the line.

faqs.q: What is the 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 Inch (in) Pipe Thread Size Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot made from?
faqs.a: The body is aluminium, which keeps the end light for a hose that is dragged and repositioned, but it wears faster than steel in abrasive blast service.

faqs.q: Which standards does the 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 Inch (in) Pipe Thread Size Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot follow?
faqs.a: The pipe thread is NPT, listed to ASME B1.20.1. That standard covers the tapered pipe thread, so seal it with thread sealant or PTFE tape as you would any NPT joint.

faqs.q: What does the 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 Inch aluminium hose end with crowfoot connect to?
faqs.a: Its female NPT thread screws onto a male NPT fitting of the same size, and its crowfoot face couples to a crowfoot half, such as the [aluminum hose end with crowfoot](/p/aluminum-hose-end-with-crowfoot) on the hose side. The [crowfoot couplings shelf](/c/crowfoot-couplings) lists the mating halves.

faqs.q: How do I install and look after the 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 Inch (in) Pipe Thread Size Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot?
faqs.a: Blast couplings wear with the hose, so inspect them and their gaskets at every make-up, pin the joint with safety clips and fit a whip check across it. Seal the NPT thread with sealant before fitting.

faqs.q: How does the 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 Inch pipe thread aluminum hose end differ from the plain crowfoot hose end?
faqs.a: This one has a female NPT pipe thread and comes in 1-1/4" and 1-1/2", with a published 110 psi rating. The [aluminum hose end with crowfoot](/p/aluminum-hose-end-with-crowfoot) is a plain hose end that also covers smaller sizes, with no published pressure.

faqs.q: What is the Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot and what is it used for?
faqs.a: The Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot is the hose-side half of a sandblast coupling: a hose end on one side and a crowfoot (claw) face on the other. It joins blast hose to a crowfoot-faced fitting, in four sizes from 3/4" to 1-1/2".

faqs.q: How do the part numbers for the Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot read?
faqs.a: The maker's codes are Q 1AL for 3/4", Q 2AL for 1", Q 3AL for 1-1/4" and Q 4AL for 1-1/2". AL marks the aluminium body, and the digit counts up with the size.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot come in?
faqs.a: The Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot is listed in 3/4", 1", 1-1/4" and 1-1/2", in 4 part numbers such as IH-SB-HOSE-END-WITH-CROWFOOT-075 and IH-SB-HOSE-END-WITH-CROWFOOT-150.

faqs.q: Which size of crowfoot hose end suits my blast hose?
faqs.a: Choose the size to match the blast hose bore: 3/4", 1", 1-1/4" or 1-1/2". Blast hose is usually bought by bore, so quote the hose bore and its outside diameter and we will confirm the end.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot?
faqs.a: The maker does not publish a working pressure for the Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot. The hose, its clamps and the medium usually set the limit before the coupling does. Give us your working pressure and medium and we will check it with the manufacturer before you order.

faqs.q: What is the Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot made from?
faqs.a: The body is aluminium. It is light on the hose and quick to handle, but it wears faster than steel in abrasive service, which is why the joint should be inspected at every make-up.

faqs.q: Which standards does the Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot follow?
faqs.a: The maker lists no thread standard for this plain crowfoot hose end, because it has no threaded end: the crowfoot face mates with another crowfoot half. Confirm that the mating half is the same crowfoot pattern before you order.

faqs.q: What does the Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot connect to?
faqs.a: Its crowfoot face couples to a crowfoot-faced half, such as the [1 1/4 to 1 1/2 inch pipe thread end](/p/1-1-4-to-1-1-2-inch-in-pipe-thread-size-aluminum-hose-end-with-crowfoot) at the blast machine or a second hose end. The [crowfoot couplings shelf](/c/crowfoot-couplings) lists more crowfoot parts.

faqs.q: How do I install and look after the Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot?
faqs.a: Blast couplings wear with the hose, so inspect them and their gaskets at every make-up, pin the joint with safety clips and fit a whip check across it.

faqs.q: How does the Aluminum Hose End with Crowfoot differ from the NPSH threaded nozzle holder?
faqs.a: This hose end has a crowfoot face, so it joins hose to hose or to a crowfoot half. The [NPSH threaded nozzle holder](/p/aluminum-npsh-threaded-hose-end-nozzle-holders) ends in an NPSH thread to carry the nozzle. Both are listed in 3/4", 1", 1-1/4" and 1-1/2".

faqs.q: What are the Aluminum NPSH Threaded Hose End Nozzle Holders and what are they used for?
faqs.a: The Aluminum NPSH Threaded Hose End Nozzle Holder is a hose end with an NPSH-threaded nozzle holder: the blast nozzle screws onto the thread, and the other end takes the blast hose. It is listed in 3/4", 1", 1-1/4" and 1-1/2".

faqs.q: How do the part numbers for the Aluminum NPSH Threaded Hose End Nozzle Holders read?
faqs.a: The maker's codes are HE 1AL for 3/4", HE 2AL for 1", HE 3AL for 1-1/4" and HE 4AL for 1-1/2". HE marks the hose-end nozzle holder and AL the aluminium body.

faqs.q: What sizes do the Aluminum NPSH Threaded Hose End Nozzle Holders come in?
faqs.a: The Aluminum NPSH Threaded Hose End Nozzle Holders are listed in 3/4", 1", 1-1/4" and 1-1/2", in 4 part numbers such as IH-SB-NPSH-THREADED-HOSE-END-NOZZLE-HOLDERS-075 and IH-SB-NPSH-THREADED-HOSE-END-NOZZLE-HOLDERS-150.

faqs.q: Which nozzle holder size do I need for my blast nozzle?
faqs.a: Match the NPSH thread of the nozzle you are fitting and the bore of the hose: 3/4", 1", 1-1/4" or 1-1/2". Quote the nozzle thread and the hose bore so we can confirm the holder.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Aluminum NPSH Threaded Hose End Nozzle Holders?
faqs.a: The maker does not publish a working pressure for the Aluminum NPSH Threaded Hose End Nozzle Holders. The hose, its clamps and the medium usually set the limit before the coupling does. Give us your working pressure and medium and we will check it with the manufacturer before you order.

faqs.q: What are the Aluminum NPSH Threaded Hose End Nozzle Holders made from?
faqs.a: The body is aluminium, which keeps the nozzle end light for the operator but wears with abrasive blast media, so check the thread and the gasket often.

faqs.q: Which standards do the Aluminum NPSH Threaded Hose End Nozzle Holders follow?
faqs.a: The nozzle thread is NPSH, listed to ASME B1.20.7. NPSH is a straight thread, so the nozzle seals on its gasket or washer and not on the thread.

faqs.q: What does the Aluminum NPSH Threaded Hose End Nozzle Holder connect to?
faqs.a: The NPSH thread carries the blast nozzle, and the hose end takes the blast hose. Use the [aluminum hose end with crowfoot](/p/aluminum-hose-end-with-crowfoot) at the machine end of the hose. For the nylon version see the [nylon sandblasting nozzle holder](/p/nylon-sandblasting-nozzle-holder).

faqs.q: How do I install and look after the Aluminum NPSH Threaded Hose End Nozzle Holders?
faqs.a: Blast couplings wear with the hose, so inspect them and their gaskets at every make-up, pin the joint with safety clips and fit a whip check across it. Replace the nozzle gasket when it is flattened or cut.

faqs.q: How does the aluminum NPSH nozzle holder differ from the nylon sandblasting nozzle holder?
faqs.a: The aluminium holder is listed in 3/4", 1", 1-1/4" and 1-1/2" with an NPSH nozzle thread. The [nylon sandblasting nozzle holder](/p/nylon-sandblasting-nozzle-holder) is a nylon part in 1-1/4" and 1-1/2" only, available in yellow or red.

faqs.q: How do the part numbers for the Nylon Sandblasting Female Thread Adapter read?
faqs.a: The two part numbers end in the size digits: -125 for 1-1/4" and -150 for 1-1/2". The female thread end is the only configuration listed for this part.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Nylon Sandblasting Female Thread Adapter come in?
faqs.a: The Nylon Sandblasting Female Thread Adapter is listed in 1-1/4" and 1-1/2", in 2 part numbers such as IH-SB-FEMALE-THREAD-ADAPTER-125 and IH-SB-FEMALE-THREAD-ADAPTER-150.

faqs.q: Which size of nylon female thread adapter do I need for my blast machine?
faqs.a: Match the male thread on the outlet you are screwing onto, 1-1/4" or 1-1/2", and the bore of the blast hose. Quote the thread type of the machine so we can confirm the adapter.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Nylon Sandblasting Female Thread Adapter?
faqs.a: The maker does not publish a working pressure for the Nylon Sandblasting Female Thread Adapter. The hose, its clamps and the medium usually set the limit before the coupling does. Give us your working pressure and medium and we will check it with the manufacturer before you order.

faqs.q: What is the Nylon Sandblasting Female Thread Adapter made from?
faqs.a: The adapter is sold as the nylon sandblasting part, and the listing names aluminium, brass, nylon and carbon steel as the material range. Nylon is light and resists impact, but it wears under abrasive media, so confirm the material of the part you are ordering.

faqs.q: Which standards does the Nylon Sandblasting Female Thread Adapter follow?

faqs.q: What does the Nylon Sandblasting Female Thread Adapter connect to?

faqs.q: How do I install and look after the Nylon Sandblasting Female Thread Adapter?

faqs.q: How does the nylon female thread adapter differ from the nylon hose coupler and nozzle holder?

faqs.q: How do the part numbers for the Nylon Sandblasting Hose Coupler read?
